name: numbered tasks, explicit after/complete
text: Task 9 extracts balances (30 minutes). Task 11 loads balances and takes about an hour; it needs Task 9 done first. Task 14 starts after Task 9 and Task 11 complete. Task 15 reconciles balances once Task 14 is finished and must be done by 06:00.

name: lags and negative lags
text: ACC-3 (reconcile accounts) can begin 15 minutes before ACC-2 (load accounts) finishes. NOT-1 (generate notices) starts two hours after ACC-3 completes so the batch can settle.

name: chains with then, parallel work is not a dependency
text: Core sequence: FRZ-1 declare the freeze, then FRZ-2 run the final extract, then MIG-1 migrate accounts. MIG-2 (statements) and MIG-3 (balances) run in parallel and both need MIG-1. REC-1 reconciles everything and requires MIG-2 and MIG-3.

name: before/blocks direction and start-to-start
text: STM-4 must finish before STM-5 can start. STM-6 blocks STM-7. STM-8 kicks off at the same moment STM-7 starts. The go/no-go call (GATE-1) happens after STM-5 and STM-7 are reconciled; SWI-1 switches routing only after GATE-1 is approved.

name: mentions of known runbook tasks
text: Balances team plan: BAL-1 pulls the balance file as soon as the final source extract is done. BAL-2 loads balances after BAL-1 and after the accounts migration has landed. BAL-3 reconciles balances after BAL-2.
